description: Get info about available Python requirements on the target host, including listing required libraries and gathering versions.

parameters.name: dependencies
parameters.description: A list of version-likes or module names to check for installation. Supported operators: <, >, <=, >=, or ==. The bare module name like ansible, the module with a specific version like boto3==1.6.1, or a partial version like requests>2 are all valid specifications. Default: []

examples:
- name: Show python lib/site paths
  community.general.python_requirements_info:

- name: Check for modern boto3 and botocore versions
  community.general.python_requirements_info:
    dependencies:
      - boto3>1.6
      - botocore<2

return_values.name: mismatched
return_values.description: A dictionary of dependencies that did not satisfy the desired version. Returned: always Sample: {"botocore": {"desired": "botocore>2", "installed": "1.10.60"}}

return_values.name: not_found
return_values.description: A list of packages that could not be imported at all, and are not installed. Returned: always Sample: ["boto4", "requests"]

return_values.name: python
return_values.description: Path to the Python interpreter used. Returned: always Sample: "/usr/local/opt/python@2/bin/python2.7"

return_values.name: python_system_path
return_values.description: List of paths Python is looking for modules in. Returned: always Sample: ["/usr/local/opt/python@2/site-packages/", "/usr/lib/python/site-packages/"]

return_values.name: python_version
return_values.description: Version of Python. Returned: always Sample: "2.7.15 (default, May 1 2018, 16:44:08)\n[GCC 4.2.1 Compatible Apple LLVM 9.1.0 (clang-902.0.39.1)]"

return_values.name: python_version_info
return_values.description: Breakdown version of Python. Returned: always

return_values.name: major
return_values.description: The major component of the python interpreter version. Returned: always Sample: 3

return_values.name: micro
return_values.description: The micro component of the python interpreter version. Returned: always Sample: 10

return_values.name: minor
return_values.description: The minor component of the python interpreter version. Returned: always Sample: 8

return_values.name: releaselevel
return_values.description: The releaselevel component of the python interpreter version. Returned: always Sample: "final"

return_values.name: serial
return_values.description: The serial component of the python interpreter version. Returned: always Sample: 0

return_values.name: valid
return_values.description: A dictionary of dependencies that matched their desired versions. If no version was specified, then desired is null. Returned: always Sample: {"boto3": {"desired": null, "installed": "1.7.60"}, "botocore": {"desired": "botocore<2", "installed": "1.10.60"}}
